GAURI SHAH 
TM/AML/KYC Analyst 
 
 
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY  
Detail-oriented and dedicated AML/KYC Analyst with 15 months of 
experience in client onboarding. Cross-trained in the UK, Malaysia, and 
default regions, with hands-on experience onboarding clients globally 
(excluding EU and sanctioned countries). Well-versed in verifying various 
types of Proof of Identity (POI) and Proof of Address (POA) documents 
across multiple jurisdictions. Skilled in using Onfido, LexisNexis, SAMS 
(Solytics Partners), and WealthKernel for customer due diligence and 
regulatory screening. Also responsible for resolving onboarding-related 
customer queries escalated via the support team. Certified in Investment 
Banking Operations from Imarticus Learning, with a B.Com degree, strong 
analytical and communication skills, and proficiency in Excel functions 
like VLOOKUP. 
Experienced with transaction monitoring and identifying suspicious 
activities. Utilizes data analysis and regulatory knowledge to ensure 
compliance and mitigate risks. Track record of enhancing anti-money 
laundering measures and improving overall transaction security.
